description: Targeted high-risk corpus for Annex III tier precision measurement
method: GitHub search by domain keyword + language:python, filtered by: OSI licence, genuine AI application (not tutorial), active repo. Search terms and selection documented per repo.

repos.name: deepface
repos.search_method: GitHub search: face recognition Python open source
repos.selection_rationale: Mature face recognition + attribute analysis library (age, gender, emotion, race). 22K stars, MIT. Biometric categorisation is Annex III Category 1.

repos.name: face_recognition
repos.selection_rationale: Canonical Python face recognition library. 56K stars, MIT. Face identification/verification is Annex III Category 1.

repos.name: AI-Resume-Analyzer
repos.search_method: GitHub search: resume screening AI Python
repos.selection_rationale: Resume screening + candidate recommendation tool. 858 stars, MIT. Employment screening is Annex III Category 4.

repos.name: Credit_Risk_Modelling
repos.search_method: GitHub search: credit risk model Python
repos.selection_rationale: PD/LGD/EAD credit risk models with ML. 81 stars, MIT. Credit scoring is Annex III Category 5(b).

repos.name: Lending-Club-Credit-Scoring
repos.search_method: GitHub search: credit scoring lending Python
repos.selection_rationale: End-to-end credit scoring with PD/EAD/LGD and credit policy design. 34 stars, MIT. Lending decisions are Annex III Category 5(b).

repos.name: Face-Biometry
repos.search_method: GitHub search: face biometric identification Python
repos.selection_rationale: Biometric face verification system on Flask. 3 stars, MIT. Identity verification is Annex III Category 1.

repos.name: Credit-Scoring-Model
repos.search_method: GitHub search: credit scoring model Python
repos.selection_rationale: Logistic regression credit scoring with decile methodology for lending decisions. No explicit licence (excluded from analysis if licence check fails).
